title: The speed curve shows under a clip and its stops drag
goal: Once a clip can ramp, an editor needs to see and shape the ramp where the clip is. Plot the clip's speed curve under it on the timeline, as the speed mock draws it, with each stop a point you drag in time and in speed.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-speed.html, CSS '.schdr/.scbody/.scaxis' (speed curve editor inside the timeline dock), swatches .sw.fast #ff5d8f and .sw.frz hatched amber, 'Speed curve 3x 1x 0'. Reuse the shared line-with-points piece the value graph and volume line use (AnimatedLineSurface.swift) rather than a third curve view. Depends on a-clip-s-speed-can-change-across-its-length-with (set in deps after filing).
acceptance: A clip with speed stops shows the mock's Speed curve under it on the timeline, on the clip's own time axis, with the 3x, 1x and 0 scale the mock prints, and the speed bands (slow, normal, fast, freeze) tinted as the mock tints them
Dragging a stop sideways moves it in time and up or down changes its speed, live in the picture, as one undo per drag; clicking the curve between stops adds one
The curve opens and closes the way a layer's other lanes open on the timeline, and takes no room on a clip with no stops
Try path, no flag changed from Next defaults: on the sample recording add two speed stops, open the clip's speed curve, drag the second stop up

Measured bar a plain line fails: the walk samples the curve area and finds the fast band in the mock's #ff5d8f and the hatched amber freeze band where the stops say, and the 1x line within 1 px of where the scale puts it; a reel of a stop being dragged goes with the audit

Audit written under queue/audits/ with the app beside the mock on one picture; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
A stop can go to zero, the mock's Freeze: one zero holds a single frame and two zeros side by side make a freeze, offered as Freeze in the stop's Speed list (the speed stops slice stops at 0.25x)

log.note: digest 2026-10-17: added a measured visual bar to the acceptance, so the flat version cannot close it (runner-prompt, work about how something looks)

From the speed stops slice (a-clip-s-speed-can-change-across-its-length-with): stops are SpeedRamp on ClipPiece (Sources/PhotonzCore/SpeedRamp.swift, SpeedStops.swift), nailed to source frames, speed linear in timeline time between stops (Ramp) or flat (Hold). A zero stop is not in the model yet: SpeedStop clamps to ClipPiece.slowestPercent, and in a source-anchored model two zeros on different frames cannot take time, so a freeze stop needs a held duration (perhaps a zero stop carrying holdMS) — added to this task's acceptance. Also still to do from the mock: the Clip section's Source / Output / Stops / Frames readout, and the mock's tip line 'A stop at zero holds a single frame, so two zeros side by side make a freeze' once zero exists.

Adversarial review before building: (1) the mock places stops by fraction of the clip's timeline; ours are nailed to recording frames, so a sideways drag solves for the frame that lands under the hand (bisection) and the neighbours bound it. (2) Two zeros side by side cannot take time in a frame-anchored model, so a zero stop carries a held length: Freeze in the Speed list makes one with a 1 s hold, drawn as the mock's two zero diamonds, the second dragging the hold longer or shorter; dragging any stop to the floor makes a single-frame zero. Two neighbouring zero stops on different frames are refused (would never end). (3) The shared animated-line rule (user 2026-10-13) says a plain click picks and Command-click adds a dot; the acceptance says click adds. The user's rule wins and the curve follows it. (4) Premiere's time remap rubber band lives on the clip and its keyframes drag up/down; ours is the mock's lane under the clip, opened by the track's arrow like the key lanes. (5) The mock also tints the clip bar itself by band and prints a legend; the curve carries the bands here, the bar tint is a follow-up.

Built: zero stops with a hold in the model (SpeedStop.holdMS, Freeze in the stop's Speed list at 1 s), SpeedCurve (core: line, handles, bands at the mock's edges), the SpeedCurveLane under a ramped clip (opens with the track's arrow, Command-click adds, diamonds drag both ways as one undo, hold end drags along, right-click Freeze/Delete), expectSpeedCurve walk step reading the ink as Display P3, dragGrip rise. Review after building: the curve and the clip do not both fit a 1280x800 timeline (106pt of tracks); the timeline scrolls to the curve when it opens, and speed-stops-ramp-walk needed a reveal for it. Left rough, under the bar: the first and last diamonds are half cut by the plot's edges, as the mock's are; the readout under the hand shows round speeds like 2.15x between the snapped ones. Filed: a-ramped-clip-s-bar-is-tinted-by-its-speed-bands (mock's clip bar tint, legend, title placement) and cutting-a-clip-in-the-middle-of-a-speed-stop-fre (reproduced). Pictures looked at: 1-two-stops, 2-dragging (2.5x readout beside the stop), 3-dragged-up (pink Fast band), 4-freeze (amber hatch between two zeros), 5-longer-hold, 6-moved-along, the reel contact sheet and the beside-the-mock picture; each shows the goal, none shows a flat plain line.

A clip with speed stops shows its Speed curve under it (SpeedCurveLane, SpeedCurve in core): mock scale 3x/1x/0, bands tinted with the mock's swatches, stops drag along and up/down as one undo, Command-click adds (shared line rule), right-click Freeze/Delete. Freeze is a zero stop that holds its frame (holdMS), first in the stop's Speed list, its second zero drags the hold. Commit b88134ed. Verified: 21 new core tests, full suite 13664 green; the-speed-curve-shows-under-a-clip-walk green at Next defaults with every band read at its exact mock swatch and the 1x line within a point; neighbouring walks green. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-17-speed-curve.json with reel, contact sheet and app-beside-mock; look card open.
